code_first.q: Trace an insertion-sort comparison between two illustrative sound bit depths.
code_first.code:
previousDepth = 16
keyDepth = 8
if previousDepth > keyDepth then
    print("Shift previous right")
else
    print("Insert key here")
endif
p: Explain what sound bit depth measures and why more bits per sample increase raw data size.
code_first.a: 16 > 8, so Shift previous right. With keyDepth 24, Insert key here. Sound bit depth is the number of bits per sample; higher bit depth increases uncompressed file size for the same sample rate and duration. This represents an insertion decision, not the whole sort.
